page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core Geekbench score of 1548.0 and a multi-core score of 7628.0. Memory performance is characterized by a cached small-block read bandwidth of 635.68 GB/sec, which drops to 40.39 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Database operations, evaluated via Passmark, score at 5838.57, while Redis SET operations reach 11.89 million operations per second.

Due to the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs, this instance is not designed for high-speed local scratch space or heavy parallel graphics processing. LLM inference benchmarks show weak performance on medium 7B models, and large 70B models are unsupported. However, the high memory density and solid memory bandwidth make it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and moderate data processing tasks.
